proposals.before: In Tianchen year 3 he followed the Last Ruler home to court and was made Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
proposals.after: In Tianjia year 3 he followed the Last Ruler home to court and was made Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天嘉 is the Chen reign Tianjia, not Tianchen.

proposals.before: In the third year of Tianchen, he followed the Last Ruler back to court, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
proposals.after: In the third year of Tianjia, he followed the Last Ruler back to court, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Kangle with a fief of five hundred households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen.

proposals.before: In Tianchen year 6 he was made Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
proposals.after: In Tianjia year 6 he was made Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen.

proposals.before: In the sixth year of Tianchen, he was established as Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
proposals.after: In the sixth year of Tianjia, he was established as Prince of Xin'an with a fief of two thousand households.
proposals.reason: Chinese 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen.

proposals.before: Seeing the cause was lost, he meant to flee; the four gates were already shut and he could not leave, so together they made for Baimang Road.
proposals.after: Seeing the cause was lost, he meant to flee; the four gates were already shut and he could not leave, so together they made for Baiyang Road.
proposals.reason: Chinese 白楊道 is Baiyang Road, as in s0063, not Baimang Road.

proposals.before: Knowing affairs would not succeed, he wished to flee; it happened that the four gates were already shut and he could not get out, so together they made for Baimang Road.
proposals.after: Knowing affairs would not succeed, he wished to flee; it happened that the four gates were already shut and he could not get out, so together they made for Baiyang Road.
proposals.reason: Chinese 白楊道 is Baiyang Road, not Baimang Road.

proposals.before: Rong arrived; mutinous troops killed him; his body lay at the gate of the Dongchang hostel; he was twenty-eight.
proposals.after: When the court cavalry arrived, he was killed by mutinous troops; his body lay at the gate of the Dongchang hostel; he was twenty-eight.
proposals.reason: Age twenty-eight and narrative context identify Bogu as the dead man; 臺馬容至 marks the court force's arrival (collation variant on 容), not a person named Rong who dies.

decisions.reason: 天嘉三年 is Chen Wen's Tianjia year 3; Tianchen misreads 嘉 as 陳. Tianjia restores the correct reign name.
Same unit: 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen. The literal replacement matches the reign name in the Chinese.
天嘉六年 is Tianjia year 6; Tianchen is the same reign misreading as in s0009. Tianjia is correct.
Same unit: 天嘉 is Tianjia, not Tianchen. The literal replacement matches the Chinese reign name.
白楊道 is Baiyang Road (白楊), not Baimang. The proposed spelling restores the toponym.
Same unit: 白楊道 is Baiyang Road. The literal replacement corrects the misread place name.

Preceding 臺馬 with collation （客） and 容至 mark the court cavalry's arrival, not a person Rong. Age 二十八 and the following edict on 伯固 identify Bogu as the dead man; the replacement removes the invented name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 容至，為亂兵所殺，尸於東昌館門，時年二十八
